title: Halloween
blurb: The most forked series in horror. Three separate continuities all branch from the 1978 original, and two of them pretend the others never happened.

h82.t: Halloween III: Season of the Witch

h88.t: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers

h89.t: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers

h95.t: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers

note: There is no single correct order here. The 2018 film ignores everything after 1978; H20 ignores parts 4 to 6; the Rob Zombie films are a separate remake line; and Halloween III has nothing to do with Michael Myers at all. Our chronological path follows the original line, then the 2018 line, then the remakes, with Halloween III last as the standalone it is.
